title: Showing up With A Knife At Neighbor’s Door Ends Badly
description:
This woman’s disastrous attempt to find her dog backfired in the worst possible way. Following the uncooperative response, officers reached the victim’s residence to investigate the break in incident. The female can be clearly seen knocking on the door while brandishing a butcher’s knife but turns away as soon as she notices the ring camera. Officers attempted to contact her and remove her from the vehicle but she was able to pull away, start her vehicle and shift it into reverse. The charged female was able to dodge law enforcement for a measly 15 minutes before a traffic stop was initiated on her vehicle. The female was charged with resisting arrest and assault on a law enforcement officer. Her bond was set at $500,000 and she was acquitted of all charges after spending 6 months in prison.
